subject: Japan with Celiac: Harder, Not Impossible

media.alt_text: Graphic summary card recapping a gluten-free trip across five Japanese cities

caption.body:
Japan was the trip I was most nervous about as a celiac, and it required more prep than anywhere else I've been.

But with GF tamari packets, a dining card as backup, and the right restaurants researched ahead of time, I ate well every single day: 5 cities, 48 places visited, 23 fully dedicated GF restaurants found.

If you're celiac and considering Japan — it's harder, not impossible. Full Japan guide with all restaurants, scores, and maps on the site (link in bio).
